metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2009 · Inglourious Basterds
metas.description: In Nazi-occupied France during World War II, a plan to assassinate Nazi leaders by a group of Jewish U.S. soldiers coincides with a theatre owner's vengeful plans for the same.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 1998 · Saving Private Ryan
metas.description: Following the Normandy Landings, a group of U.S. soldiers go behind enemy lines to retrieve a paratrooper whose brothers have been killed in action.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 1995 · Braveheart
metas.description: Scottish warrior William Wallace leads his countrymen in a rebellion to free his homeland from the tyranny of King Edward I of England.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1987 · Full Metal Jacket
metas.description: A pragmatic U.S. Marine observes the dehumanizing effects the Vietnam War has on his fellow recruits from their brutal boot camp training to the bloody street fighting in Hue.

April 6th, 1917. As an infantry battalion assembles to wage war deep in enemy territory, two soldiers are assigned to race against time and deliver a message that will stop 1,600 men from walking straight into a deadly trap.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 1979 · Apocalypse Now
metas.description: A U.S. Army officer serving in Vietnam is tasked with assassinating a renegade Special Forces Colonel who sees himself as a god.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2007 · Pan's Labyrinth
metas.description: In 1944 Francoist Spain, an imaginative young girl meets a faun who tells her she's a princess and that she must prove her worthiness by completing three dangerous tasks.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 1943 · Casablanca
metas.description: A cynical expatriate American cafe owner struggles to decide whether or not to help his former lover and her fugitive husband escape the Nazis in French Morocco.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2014 · Fury
metas.description: A grizzled tank commander makes tough decisions as he and his crew fight their way across Germany in April, 1945.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2009 · The Hurt Locker
metas.description: During the Iraq War, a Sergeant recently assigned to an army bomb squad is put at odds with his squad mates due to his maverick way of handling his work.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2019 · Jojo Rabbit
metas.description: A young German boy in the Hitler Youth, whose hero and imaginary friend is the country's dictator, is shocked to discover that his mother is hiding a Jewish girl in their home.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1986 · Platoon
metas.description: Chris Taylor, a neophyte recruit in Vietnam, finds himself caught in a battle of wills between two sergeants, one good and the other evil. A shrewd examination of the brutality of war and the duality of man in conflict.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 1989 · Grave of the Fireflies
metas.description: A young boy and his little sister struggle to survive in Japan during World War II.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1979 · The Deer Hunter
metas.description: The lives of a group of friends are forever changed by the Vietnam War.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1939 · Gone with the Wind
metas.description: A sheltered and manipulative Southern belle and a roguish profiteer face off in a turbulent romance as the society around them crumbles with the end of slavery and is rebuilt during the Civil War and Reconstruction periods.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2022 · All Quiet on the Western Front
metas.description: A young German soldier's eagerness to serve his country quickly fades when he witnesses the horrors of combat on the Western Front during World War I.
